role: Tests for CloudPayloadCodec (EMQC envelope round trip, magic/version framing, legacy pass-through, tamper/truncation failures, key stability and multi-key opening, primary-account choice, live-backup chain) and, in a second class, CloudSettingsRecord encryption/legacy-plaintext handling and Health-filled profile stripping. Both classes stand in for a confirmed iCloud account in setUp (standInForConfirmedICloudAccount, an XCTestCase extension here that ArchiveIntegrityTests uses too), since a cloud key is created only for one.
types: CloudPayloadCodecTests: class — XCTestCase over CloudPayloadCodec using the real Keychain
CloudSettingsRecordTests: class — XCTestCase over CloudSettingsRecord read/write on locally built CKRecords
